title: Algebraic separable extensions are filtered colimits of finite etale algebras
statement:
Let $L/K$ be an algebraic separable extension of fields. Then $L$ is a
filtered colimit of finite separable extensions of $K$; each of those is a
finite etale $K$-algebra, hence a smooth $K$-algebra, so $L$ is a
filtered colimit of smooth $K$-algebras.

proof.text: Index by finite subsets s of L and take A(s) = K[s] as a subalgebra of L. Inclusions of finite subsets induce algebra inclusions. Finite unions are upper bounds, so the index poset is filtered. Each x lies in A({x}), so the supremum of the A(s) is L.

For a cocone, Subalgebra.iSupLift gives an algebra map on the supremum, identified with L. Its compatibility for any inclusion A(s) ≤ A(t) follows by mapping both stages to A(s ∪ t) and using cocone naturality. The iSupLift inclusion equation proves the cocone factorization; singleton stages prove uniqueness. This constructs the colimit presentation directly in CommAlgCat, with independent universes for K and L.

Algebraicity implies each A(s) is a field (Subalgebra.isField_of_algebraic); integrality of its finite generating set implies Module.Finite K A(s) (Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral). Separability descends along A(s) → L (Algebra.IsSeparable.of_algHom). Apply lem-weil-pbc-finite-separable-extension-etale, then the Algebra.Etale-to-Algebra.Smooth instance of Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Basic. This is the affine smoothness notion of def-sbc-smooth-morphisms. Package the presentation and these properties as ObjectProperty.ind.
